risk_note: RV2 (orders status map; order void / clawback classification). D10-867 (owner 2026-11-07 18:09「订单失效就好了」, replacing D10-529 ⑥): JD validCode 13, 25-28, 36-43 are added to specs/order-status-map/jd.csv as PLATFORM_INVALID (source doc, verified false, note 「无效-违规（D10-867）」), the same as code 30. Before: unmapped codes (pending UNMAPPED_STATUS + hold before credit, whole update refused after credit, no order row on first sight). After: first sight builds the row and voids it (P13 → R6 VOID, reason REFUND); unbooked orders void (R6); credited orders are clawed back in full under the existing invalid rule (R8, sub_type FULL). No change to PUNISH, reason_sub, the state machines, amounts rules or code; the 14 / 40 slot-mismatch warning is unchanged. Frozen fixture test/spec/orders/jd-status-map/kit.ts moved only these 13 codes from UNMAPPED into INVALID_CODES (D10-327).
